description:
[Game reference] Every explosive: damage, blast radius, fuse, dud chance, fire and sulfur. Every raid explosive, fire source and siege round from the server files: `damage` by type (vs buildings and
deployables) and `player_damage` when players take something different; `radius_m` with full damage inside
`min_radius_m`, falling off linearly to nothing at `radius_m` (`splash`: `parent` = C4/satchel, full damage only to
what it is stuck to plus falloff to deployables/players around it; `radius` = everything in range; `impact` =
bullets, with `radial` splash); `fuse_s` [min, max]; `dud` (`chance`) and `lit_per_success` (expected lights per
explosion); `fire` (burst Heat, fireballs, each fireball's Heat/s, life, radius and `spread` with
`expected_total` fireballs); `handling` (draw / between-throw seconds, throw speed); `launcher`; `sulfur` per unit;
`walls` = how many break one wood/stone/sheet metal/armored wall from `outside` (hard side) and `inside`. `rules`
quotes the game code each mechanic comes from. Page: rust.wiki/explosives. Every explosive at once; for one use get_explosive. Link https://rust.wiki/explosives.

group.description: One group: `placed` (C4 & satchels), `thrown` (Grenades), `rocket` (Rockets & launchers), `fire` (Fire), `ammo` (Explosive & incendiary ammo), `siege` (Siege & heavy weapons), `other` (Other).
